t: Fortress 5Ltr Natural Decking Oil is a high-performance, water-based oil specifically formulated to protect and enhance the beauty of outdoor timber decking. This quick-drying decking oil becomes touch-dry and recoatable in just one hour, making it an efficient solution for busy trade professionals and extensive garden projects. It offers excellent water-repellent and water-resistant properties, helping to guard against the elements and prolong the life of the wood. The breathable formula allows timber to maintain its natural state, while its low odour ensures a more pleasant application experience. Ideal for restoring or protecting garden decking, it applies easily with a brush or roller to achieve a natural finish.
